resources.string: Create one focused diagnostic package, inspect its contents, then save a copy if needed. Stored packages do not verify the current app view.
Load manually to start. Opening this page does not sample your system.
Working… You can return to this page to check the result.
This request could not be verified. Check the result before repeating a change.
This controller does not advertise the required package workflow.
Package workflow is available. Saved data and diagnostic status are separate.
Use a current stable ID. A kernel rule ID or submission ID cannot replace it.
Default: replace identifiers with aliases within this package. Paths, logs, credentials and command arguments are omitted in both modes. Redaction does not guarantee anonymity.
This package will retain real module, definition, operation and runtime identifiers allowed by the diagnostic format. Review the complete contents before exporting.
Check the scenario and ID fields. IDs must use the required format and the request must fit the input limit.
Up to 8 packages; 96 KiB per package. Nothing is removed automatically.
I have reviewed this package and its privacy mode
Choose a destination. Cancelling keeps the saved package.
Copy saved. The package is still retained locally.
Copy could not be confirmed. The source package is retained; check or delete any partial destination file.
The export session was lost. Preview the package again before choosing a new destination.
Only this retained package will be removed. Exported copies, input files, logs, configuration and runtime rules will remain.
This ID was saved before a create or remove request. Query it to inspect the current result. The change will not be replayed.
The package is not currently retained. This does not prove it was never created or exported.
Package saved. Inspect the diagnostic status separately.
The package ID or reviewed revision conflicts. Refresh and preview before another change.
The package store was not replaced by this request. Check the reason before trying again.
The result is unknown. Query the saved package ID; do not repeat the change automatically.
The local operation checkpoint could not be verified. New changes are disabled to preserve the existing record.
